data.title: Remove stale GPU locks and clarify exceptional handoffs
data.body: Reconcile Lux instructions/checkpoints with P112/P117: routine isolated low-resolution functional checks may run concurrently subject to observed resource limits. Reserve uncontended runs for performance measurements or demonstrated conflicts. For necessary shared-resource handoffs, retain the holder until explicit cleanup/release and use unique grants so delayed messages cannot authorize overlap. Keep general handoff guidance in canonical Conductor skills through normal install; Lux GPU specifics stay local. Validate fresh-agent scenarios for routine concurrency, measured contention, and delayed grants. No scheduler, daemon, or blanket lock. Evidence: LUX-P112/P117/P122.
